ValidationRule.description: User should populate any one Sync Status fields related to Campaign member sync functionality
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(CM_ER_Auto_Sync__c , 'Yes'), OR( ISBLANK(Campaign__c), AND( ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Cancelled_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Checked_In_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Checked_Out_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Declined_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Did_Not_Attend_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Invited_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_New_Status__c), ISBLANK(Event_Reg_Registered_Status__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate Campaign and any one Sync Status fields before enabling Campaign Member Auto Sync
